restoration_note: Teaching describes three discrete degrees of the regenerate human — pneumatic (New Man as seat of Mind of Light), psychic (residue bound to flesh, the Old Man), somatic (containing body) — and the daily soul-cycle of descent through eating and ascent through purification, with the Virgin of Light leading the soul to seal in the Indweller. Most gaps are short formulaic completions confirmed by editor: icon-triad opener, copula ⲡⲉ, Virgin-of-Light formula, ⲍⲱⲣⲣⲁⲫⲉ-paint formula, ⲥⲱⲧⲏ-ⲁⲃⲁⲗ redeem-forth formula, ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ/ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ Greek terms, ⲧⲙⲛⲧϩⲁⲣⲱϩⲏⲧ patience-virtue. Three structural restorations beyond editor: {15} ⲛⲥⲍⲉⲓⲉ from verbatim parallel later in chapter; {20} ⲙⲁⲁϫⲧ̄ from verbatim parallel; {46}/{47} split of ⲛⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ across line-break. Larger lacunae in mid-chapter (downward/upward motion clauses, vice-list expansions in {21}/{22}/{48}/{49}) remain too damaged: the vice-list is partially canonical (bitterness/desire/foolishness/envy/discord/teachings) but order varies between the two listings, so individual slots cannot be securely fixed.

restorations.basis: Editor: existential ⲟⲩⲛ̄ 'there are' opening the triad enumeration.
Editor: completes ⲧϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ 'three' (fem.) modifying ⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ across the line break, matching the chapter title's ⲧϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ ⲛⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ.
Editor: ⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲧⲉ 'the first is' — standard enumeration opener; first of three in the triad.
Editor: single letter completing ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ across line break.
Editor: copula ⲡⲉ in ⲉⲧⲉ ⲡⲣⲙⲛⲃⲣⲣⲉ ⲡⲉ 'which is the New Man' — standard identification formula recurring on this page.
Editor: ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ 'inward' — the Mind of Light goes inward (ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ) into the New Man and dwells in him; standard soteriological direction.
Editor: definite article ⲡ̄ before ⲥⲱⲭⲡ̄ ('residue' = ⲡⲥⲱⲭⲡ̄ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲥⲉⲡⲉ).
Editor: genitive ⲛ̄ before ⲧⲯⲩⲭⲓⲕⲟⲛ — 'the icon of the psychic'.
Editor: completes ⲯⲩⲭⲓⲕⲟⲛ across line break.

3-character lacuna between 'Old Man' and 'ϣ': several parsings possible (ⲡⲉ-copula vs. continuation of clause), and the relation between visible ϣ and following ⲛ̄ⲛ̄ⲥⲁⲡ ('from the time') is not determined. Insufficient constraint.
Editor: ⲭ for ϫ in ϫⲓⲛ-ⲛ̄-ⲥⲁⲡ 'from the time' — the temporal phrase 'from the time of the psychic icon' marking the duration of the Old Man's coincidence with the psychic state.

Third icon in the triad (pneumatic/psychic/somatic) named explicitly elsewhere in the chapter; the somatic is precisely the icon 'which contains them all' as outermost vessel — confirmed by the spiritual reading.
13-character lacuna at start of clause about the three icons 'unto the All'; phrasing not constrained by extant parallels.
3-character lacuna following 'the hour when...'; verb of the temporal clause not fixed by parallel.
4-character lacuna preceding ⲟⲩⲛ; 'inward' (ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ) suggested by English but Coptic preceding word not securely fixed.

Verbatim parallel later in chapter line 16: 'ⲛⲥⲍⲉⲓ̈ⲉ ⲁⲧⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ' ('and she falls unto the icon'). Same downward-motion verb governs the soul's drop to the somatic at end of line 13. Six characters fits est.
4-character word preceding ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward'; could be a connective or another motion verb but not constrained.
Editor: ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲟⲡ — standard relative formulation 'the somatic which exists in her', resuming the descent into the somatic icon.
10-character lacuna preceding 'as she also is conveyed upward'; introduces the ascent phase but specific phrasing not constrained.
Editor: ϣⲁⲥⲃⲁϣⲥ̄ habitual 'she habitually pours her' — same form recurs in this chapter for the soul's pouring through icons.

Verbatim parallel in line 36: 'ⲛⲉⲓ̈ ⲉⲧⲙⲁⲁϫⲧ̄ ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲥ' ('these which are mingled with her'). The 'enemies which {20}' clause naturally takes 'are mingled' (with-her), describing the corrupt affections in the psychic. Lycopolitan ⲙⲁⲁϫⲧ̄ from ⲙⲟⲩϫⲧ.

11-character lacuna in vice-list before 'wrath, desire'. Several canonical vices possible (bitterness, foolishness, etc.) but order in this listing differs from the parallel later list, so specific items cannot be fixed.
4-character lacuna continuing the vice-list after 'desire'; particular item not constrained.
16-character lacuna ending in '-with her'; likely closing the vice-list with relative clause 'mingled with her' but specific phrasing not fixed.
Editor: ϣⲁⲡⲉ = ϣⲱⲡⲉ in Lyc; ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ϣⲁⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ 'then there comes to be a virgin' — narrative pivot to the Virgin of Light's appearance.

Editor: completes ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'Virgin of Light' (lexicon-fixed cosmic figure who reveals herself, blazes path, and conducts soul to Indweller per the spiritual reading) + motion verb ⲉⲓ + conjunctive ⲛⲥ-.
Editor: ⲛ̄ⲧⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ 'from the icon' — locative source of the Virgin's revealing.
Editor: genitive marker ⲙ̄ before ⲡⲛⲧⲕ̄ⲛ 'the Indweller'.
Editor: locative 'in her' (fem. — the soul/Virgin); the Indweller exists in her, identified as the New Man — matches the spiritual reading's 'pneumatic icon = seat of the Indweller'.
Editor: single letter completing ⲡ[ⲣ]ⲙⲛⲃⲣⲡⲉ 'the New Man'.

Editor: ⲛⲥⲃⲱⲕ 'and (she) travels' — 3sg.f conjunctive of ⲃⲱⲕ; continues into next line's visible 'ⲱⲕ'.
Editor: completes ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place' — destination of the Virgin's upward leading; the 'height' to which she draws the soul.
Editor: 3sg.f conjunctive prefix before ϫⲓⲧⲥ̄ 'takes her' — continues the chain of conjunctive verbs of the Virgin's leading.
Editor: completes ⲍⲱⲣⲣⲁⲫⲉ 'paint' (Greek ζωγραφεῖν); the New Man paints the soul into the icon of the Indweller.
Editor: completes verb ending; 'paints her and adorns her in the New Man'.
Editor: start of ϩⲓϩⲟⲩⲛ 'inside/within' — the inward sealing in the New Man.
Editor: completes ϩⲓϩⲟⲩⲛ 'inside'.
Editor: completes ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ 'Virgin' across line break — the seal taken in all the members of the Virgin of Light.
Editor: completes ⲧϩⲉ 'the manner' (Lyc = Sah ⲑⲉ) — opens the universal application of the type.
Editor: start of ⲥⲱⲧⲏ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'redeemed forth' — Lyc form; the Living Member is habitually redeemed from every life. Continues into next line's ⲧⲏ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ.
Editor: completes ⲥⲱⲧⲏ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'redeemed forth' — formulaic phrase for the redemption of the Living Member.
Editor: completes ⲡⲁⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ (Lyc form of δίκαιος, 'Righteous one') — the body of the Righteous one outside, in the dispensation of prophecy.
Editor: completes ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ 'type' (Greek τύπος); 'the type in this manner' opens the universal pattern statement.
Editor: completes ⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̄ϩⲟⲟⲩⲉ ⲛⲓⲙ 'purified every day' — the daily purification of the Living Soul through the three icons (key arc-statement of the chapter).

After visible ⲛ and before next line's ⲕ, the natural completion is ⲛ̄ⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ 'icons' (= ⲧⲓⲱⲁⲙⲧⲉ ⲛⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ 'these three icons'), splitting at ⲛⲍⲓ-/ⲕⲱⲛ. The 'three icons' is the chapter's controlling structure.
Continuation of ⲛⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ split across line break; the ⲕ at line-start + ⲱⲛ completes the word ('icons').

Editor: completes ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲥ 'she' — the closing identification: she also is the last (lexicon: ⲧϩⲁⲏ 'last/consummating'). Closes the first/last pair.
